messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
From which date do Articles 26 to 42 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (notification of conformity assessment bodies) apply?

response.text: A partire da quale data si applicano gli articoli da 26 a 42 del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 (notifica degli organismi di valutazione della conformità)?
